03 / ABOUT ME

An engineer’s mindset.
A builder’s curiosity.

I’m Saqib Nazir, a DevOps engineer based in Lisbon, Portugal, with more than five years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, configuration management, and CI/CD.

My work spans automated delivery pipelines, Ansible-based provisioning, and the move from monolithic applications to Docker containers and Kubernetes. I’m currently at Sovos, and previously worked with Blue Cross Blue Shield Association on behalf of Unravel AI.
